text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What?! You can make snow that doesn't 
melt?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! An online video said you could 
make it with baking soda and conditioner!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa~! I wanna give it a shot too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, wicked cool! It's all powdery, feels 
way more like real snow than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I put 'em in the fridge, they might 
feel more authentic~. Real chilly, making 
that squeaky sound when you walk—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm startin' to miss real snow.
